tagline: 110 × 85cm of flat memory foam, so a big dog can stretch out fully on their side.
lead: A big dog can lie flat out on their side, with memory foam under every part of them.
value: Foam sits under the whole surface, so there's no thin spot at the sides and no stuffing to shift into lumps.
intro: Whitebeam is a large orthopaedic memory foam dog mattress, 110 × 85cm and 10cm deep, with no walls or bolsters. The cover zips off and goes in the washing machine.
points: A flat, open 110 × 85cm footprint with no bolsters eating into it.
No thin spot at the sides and no stuffing to shift into lumps.
Cushions the hips and elbows a big dog rests their weight on.
A level edge with nothing to climb over.
It zips off for the washing machine. The foam stays out of the wash.
best_for: Large breeds, side sleepers and sprawlers who change position through the night.
fit_note: It comes in one size. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm; the whole surface is usable. Not sure it fits? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Large Flat Memory Foam Dog Mattress, 110 × 85cm | Snoozly
seo_description: Room for a big dog to stretch out flat: a 110 × 85cm orthopaedic memory foam dog mattress, 10cm deep, no bolsters. Zip-off machine-washable cover.
